exposure: IGF axis components (PAPP-A, PAPP-A2, IGFBP-4, IGFBP-5, IGF-I, IGF-II)
cohort: Neonates born at a tertiary teaching hospital in Boston (N = 180)
finding: Umbilical cord blood levels of IGF-I, IGF-II, total IGFBP-4, and IGFBP-5 were positively associated with birth weight and length, while intact IGFBP-4, PAPP-A, and PAPP-A2 levels were negatively associated.
birth_weight: Infants were categorized as SGA, AGA, or LGA
